jobs.title: Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager
to join our Customer Experience team at Pleo. In this role, you’ll own a portfolio of large, complex, and strategically important enterprise customers, helping them achieve measurable business outcomes, expand adoption, manage change, and build long-term value with Pleo.

You’ll serve as a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders while coordinating the broader Pleo relationship across Customer Success, Product, Support, Sales, Finance, and other internal teams.

This is not a reactive account-management role. You’ll be expected to understand each customer’s business priorities, operating model, success criteria, and risk profile. You’ll turn that understanding into clear success plans, executive engagement strategies, adoption programs, renewal plans, and growth opportunities.

The right candidate will bring at least three years of direct experience managing enterprise customers
, along with the communication skills, commercial judgment, and operational discipline required to manage high-value relationships in a fast-paced technology environment.

Who You’ll Be Working With And Reporting To

You’ll report to our Manager of Customer Success, Large & High-Growth Customers
and work closely with teams across:

Customer Support
Customer Onboarding
Sales and Account Management
Product and Product Operations
Revenue Operations
Finance
Data and Analytics
Program Management and Operations

You’ll work with customer stakeholders across finance, procurement, operations, technology, transformation, and executive leadership.

You’ll be responsible for creating alignment across these stakeholders, establishing clear governance, and ensuring Pleo remains connected to the customer’s evolving strategic and operational priorities.

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager
, you will:

Own a portfolio of enterprise customers with accountability for customer health, value realisation, adoption, retention, renewal readiness, advocacy, and growth.
Build trusted relationships with senior and executive stakeholders, positioning yourself as a credible advisor who understands their business priorities and operating environment.
Develop detailed customer success plans that connect the customer’s strategic goals to measurable outcomes, adoption milestones, responsibilities, and timelines.
Lead executive business reviews and strategic customer meetings that demonstrate value, address risks, align stakeholders, and create clear next steps.
Drive product adoption across complex customer organisations, helping customers expand usage across teams, entities, locations, use cases, and workflows.
Create and maintain detailed stakeholder maps, identifying decision-makers, champions, influencers, operational contacts, blockers, and executive sponsors.
Identify churn risk early using product usage, engagement, stakeholder, support, financial, organisational, and external business signals.
Build and execute churn-prevention plans with clear actions, owners, timelines, customer commitments, and executive escalation paths.
Maintain detailed and accurate forecasts across renewals, risk, customer health, expected outcomes, growth opportunities, and major account milestones.
Lead renewal-readiness activities by ensuring customer value is documented, risks are addressed, stakeholders are aligned, and commercial partners have accurate account intelligence.
Identify and support expansion opportunities by connecting additional Pleo capabilities, products, or use cases to the customer’s evolving business needs.
Coordinate complex customer escalations across Support, Product, Engineering, Finance, and other teams while maintaining clear and confident customer communication.
Act as the customer’s internal advocate, ensuring customer needs, feedback, risks, and opportunities are visible to the right stakeholders at Pleo.
Navigate customer change effectively, including leadership transitions, reorganisations, acquisitions, market expansion, platform changes, and evolving business priorities.
Track customer commitments and outcomes with strong operational discipline, ensuring actions are documented, owned, and completed.
Contribute to the evolution of Pleo’s enterprise Customer Success model by sharing best practices, customer insights, playbooks, and recommendations.
Support peer development and knowledge sharing across the Customer Success team without holding direct people-management responsibility.

To put things into context

In this role, you can expect to work on priorities such as:

strengthening relationships with Pleo’s largest and most strategic customers
improving enterprise customer retention and renewal predictability
increasing adoption across complex customer organisations
creating stronger executive engagement and governance
identifying churn risk before it becomes a renewal issue
improving forecast accuracy and account visibility
coordinating complex customer needs across multiple internal teams
helping customers quantify and communicate the value they receive from Pleo
identifying opportunities for expansion and deeper product adoption
improving the consistency and quality of enterprise success planning
helping customers navigate operational and organisational change
turning customer feedback into actionable Product and CX insight

You can expect to work across a technology environment that includes CRM, Customer Success platforms, support systems, product analytics, business intelligence tools, workflow tools, and collaboration platforms
.

Examples may include Vitally, Gainsight or similar, Zendesk, Looker, Tableau or Power BI, Jira, Asana, and Slack.

What You Bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

At least three years of direct enterprise Customer Success or strategic account-management experience, managing large, complex, and high-value B2B customers.
Five or more years of overall experience in Customer Success, account management, consulting, implementation, or a related customer-facing role.
Experience working in SaaS, fintech, enterprise technology, or another complex B2B technology environment.
A proven record of retaining and growing enterprise customers, including managing renewals, adoption, risk, and value realisation.
Strong executive relationship-management skills, with the confidence and credibility to engage senior decision-makers and business leaders.
Experience managing complex stakeholder environments involving multiple teams, business units, regions, entities, or decision-makers.
Strong churn-prediction and prevention skills, including the ability to interpret customer signals, identify root causes, and build effective recovery plans.
Detailed forecasting experience across renewals, customer risk, account health, adoption, and expansion opportunities.
Strong commercial judgment, with an understanding of how customer outcomes connect to retention, revenue, expansion, and long-term account value.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to lead difficult conversations, present to executives, and simplify complex issues.
Experience building strategic success plans, account plans, stakeholder maps, and executive business reviews.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret customer data, product usage, service trends, and business information.
Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to align internal stakeholders without relying on direct authority.
A structured and proactive approach to account management, with excellent follow-through and attention to detail.
Comfort working in a fast-paced growth environment where customer expectations, internal priorities, and business needs can evolve quickly.
The ability to balance strategic relationship management with detailed operational execution.

Nice to have

Experience in fintech, payments, spend management, financial operations, or expense-management technology
Experience working with finance leaders, procurement teams, controllers, CFO organisations, or transformation leaders
Experience managing multi-country or multinational enterprise customers
Familiarity with ERP, accounting, procurement, or financial-system integrations
Experience supporting customers through significant organisational or technology transformation
Exposure to AI-enabled Customer Success, predictive health models, automated risk detection, or digital engagement
Experience partnering with Product teams on strategic customer feedback and roadmap discussions
Experience managing accounts with complex security, compliance, governance, or implementation requirements

Why is this role a good fit for you?

This role is a good fit for you if:

You enjoy building strategic relationships with complex enterprise customers.
You are comfortable engaging senior leaders and navigating high-stakes customer situations.
You know how to connect product adoption to measurable customer outcomes.
You are proactive about identifying and addressing churn risk.
You combine strong relationship skills with rigorous account-management discipline.
You are confident leading executive reviews, renewal discussions, and difficult customer conversations.
You enjoy coordinating internal teams around complex customer needs.
You want direct responsibility for protecting and growing some of Pleo’s most important customer relationships.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

You have not directly managed enterprise or strategic customer relationships.
You prefer transactional or high-volume customer portfolios.
You are uncomfortable owning customer risk, retention, and renewal readiness.
You prefer reacting to customer requests rather than building proactive engagement strategies.
You are uncomfortable engaging executive stakeholders or leading difficult conversations.
You do not enjoy detailed forecasting, CRM management, and account planning.
You prefer working independently without significant cross-functional coordination.
You are looking for a people-management role rather than a senior individual-contributor position.

How You’ll Develop In This Role

In your first 1 month at Pleo, you’ll:

Learn Pleo’s product, enterprise customer journey, value proposition, and Customer Success operating model.
Build a detailed understanding of your customer portfolio, including revenue, renewal dates, usage, stakeholders, open issues, risks, and growth potential.

Review and improve success plans, stakeholder maps, account plans, and risk assessments.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
We're on a mission to be a Force For Good, through our People, Products and Purpose at Nuix. Nuix is one of the greatest comeback Technology success stories in Australia, and we're making massive waves each day. Nuix is, and will be, a pioneer in the Australian Technology space, and we're carrying the torch on what "good" looks like.

This extends to our People. We're fiercely passionate, love working at pace, thrive in ambiguity, live, and breathe outside of the box, and above all are good humans. Our impact extends outside of our 9-5, and our place in society isn't always defined by corporate metrics. We're determined to make a positive difference in the world, whether through our solutions which help the top companies, governments and agencies find the truth and combat illegal activities, or through our people who care about contributing and giving back both within, and outside, of Nuix. We are a Force For Good.

We're selective about who comes on board, and you should be too. But if the above sounds like a match, get in touch today and get ready for the possibility of starting a once-in-a-career journey.

Role Overview

The Customer Success Manager (Platform) is Nuix's primary post-sale relationship owner across an assigned portfolio of enterprise accounts. From the point of contract close, this role holds accountability for adoption, value realisation, retention and expansion — coordinating with implementation and professional services teams as the engagement matures, and acting as the consistent point of continuity for the customer throughout their Nuix lifecycle.

This is a commercially oriented, individually delivered role that balances relationship depth with revenue outcomes. The successful candidate will bring a consultative approach to enterprise accounts operating in data-intensive, compliance-driven or investigative environments, and will be comfortable managing a portfolio that spans both relationship stewardship and billable advisory engagement.

new_jobs.title: Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager
to join our Customer Experience team at Pleo. In this role, you’ll own a portfolio of large, complex, and strategically important enterprise customers, helping them achieve measurable business outcomes, expand adoption, manage change, and build long-term value with Pleo.

You’ll serve as a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders while coordinating the broader Pleo relationship across Customer Success, Product, Support, Sales, Finance, and other internal teams.

This is not a reactive account-management role. You’ll be expected to understand each customer’s business priorities, operating model, success criteria, and risk profile. You’ll turn that understanding into clear success plans, executive engagement strategies, adoption programs, renewal plans, and growth opportunities.

The right candidate will bring at least three years of direct experience managing enterprise customers
, along with the communication skills, commercial judgment, and operational discipline required to manage high-value relationships in a fast-paced technology environment.

Who You’ll Be Working With And Reporting To

You’ll report to our Manager of Customer Success, Large & High-Growth Customers
and work closely with teams across:

Customer Support
Customer Onboarding
Sales and Account Management
Product and Product Operations
Revenue Operations
Finance
Data and Analytics
Program Management and Operations

You’ll work with customer stakeholders across finance, procurement, operations, technology, transformation, and executive leadership.

You’ll be responsible for creating alignment across these stakeholders, establishing clear governance, and ensuring Pleo remains connected to the customer’s evolving strategic and operational priorities.

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager
, you will:

Own a portfolio of enterprise customers with accountability for customer health, value realisation, adoption, retention, renewal readiness, advocacy, and growth.
Build trusted relationships with senior and executive stakeholders, positioning yourself as a credible advisor who understands their business priorities and operating environment.

new_jobs.description:
We're on a mission to be a Force For Good, through our People, Products and Purpose at Nuix. Nuix is one of the greatest comeback Technology success stories in Australia, and we're making massive waves each day. Nuix is, and will be, a pioneer in the Australian Technology space, and we're carrying the torch on what "good" looks like.

This extends to our People. We're fiercely passionate, love working at pace, thrive in ambiguity, live, and breathe outside of the box, and above all are good humans. Our impact extends outside of our 9-5, and our place in society isn't always defined by corporate metrics. We're determined to make a positive difference in the world, whether through our solutions which help the top companies, governments and agencies find the truth and combat illegal activities, or through our people who care about contributing and giving back both within, and outside, of Nuix. We are a Force For Good.

We're selective about who comes on board, and you should be too. But if the above sounds like a match, get in touch today and get ready for the possibility of starting a once-in-a-career journey.

Role Overview

The Customer Success Manager (Platform) is Nuix's primary post-sale relationship owner across an assigned portfolio of enterprise accounts. From the point of contract close, this role holds accountability for adoption, value realisation, retention and expansion — coordinating with implementation and professional services teams as the engagement matures, and acting as the consistent point of continuity for the customer throughout their Nuix lifecycle.

This is a commercially oriented, individually delivered role that balances relationship depth with revenue outcomes. The successful candidate will bring a consultative approach to enterprise accounts operating in data-intensive, compliance-driven or investigative environments, and will be comfortable managing a portfolio that spans both relationship stewardship and billable advisory engagement.

Location:

This position will be based in our Reston office. The candidate is required to attend the office a minimum of 3 days per week but may voluntarily elect to work either remotely or from the Reston office for the remaining days of the week.

We are also open to fully remote candidates on the West Coast,
as we have customers across the US and this allows for full coverage.

We're excited to be hiring multiple team members for this role, creating several opportunities for qualified candidates to join our growing organization.

Responsibilities

Own the post-sale relationship for an assigned portfolio of enterprise accounts from contract close through renewal. Serve as the single point of continuity across the customer lifecycle, coordinating internal handovers from sales and professional services with precision.
Deliver billable advisory engagements that drive measurable product adoption and customer outcomes. Maintain a 50% billability target by scoping and executing paid services that create demonstrable value against each customer's defined success criteria.
Execute a disciplined renewal management cadence, initiating commercial conversations at least 90 days prior to contract expiry. Prepare renewal business cases grounded in realised outcomes, product usage data and forward roadmap relevance to secure and protect recurring revenue.
Identify, qualify and progress upsell and cross-sell opportunities within the existing account portfolio. Maintain a documented pipeline of expansion opportunities in the CRM and collaborate with sales to advance opportunities to close, targeting NDR above 110%.
Conduct structured quarterly business reviews with senior customer stakeholders, including C-suite engagement where appropriate. Present product usage insights, value delivered to date and a forward success plan that ties Nuix capability to the customer's strategic priorities.
Monitor customer health signals and act on early indicators of risk or disengagement before they escalate. Use platform usage data, support history and engagement patterns to maintain accurate health scores and trigger proactive outreach or escalation where required.

Must Haves

Five or more years of experience in customer success, account management or consulting within enterprise B2B software. Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding retention and expansion targets across a portfolio of complex, high-value accounts.
Commercial acumen with direct experience owning renewal conversations and identifying revenue expansion opportunities. Comfortable navigating procurement cycles, articulating ROI and managing objections with both operational users and executive stakeholders.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build credible relationships across technical and non-technical audiences. Proven ability to present complex ideas clearly at C-suite level and to translate product capability into customer-relevant business outcomes.
Proficiency with CRM and customer success platforms for pipeline management, health scoring and renewal forecasting. Able to maintain accurate account data, activity logs and opportunity records that provide a reliable basis for portfolio reporting and forecasting.

Nice To Haves
